svg.title: HamiltonLab finite-window observable variance
svg.desc: Five exact-flow Gaussian references compare position and squared-position averages, including zero position correlation with frozen magnitude. Same linear axes in every panel, N1 through40, variance factor0 through1.
svg.text: HamiltonLab | a stable mean can hide frozen magnitude
Exact Gaussian flow references, stationary start. Not sampled leapfrog trajectories or convergence evidence.
Shared linear scale0..1. Every integer N1..40.
Position correlations vanish; magnitude stays fixed.
Lines join integer window-length summaries, not sample paths. Zero variance of one average is not exploration.
Full curve data: python examples/render_windows.py --json /tmp/window-curves.json | see README derivations and limits.
